grades.main_gap: The crux—proving finite stabilization, i.e., that some S_N is pairwise non-coprime (equivalently, only finitely many primes ever appear)—is only conjectured, not proved. The all-n periodicity indexing is also left implicit.
grades.notes: Correct and useful pieces: bounded gaps via multiples of a_1; correct sufficient criterion for stabilization; periodicity of a stabilized S_N and sketch of the translation argument; verified worked example (a_1=15, T=8, L=30). But the central existence lemma is absent ('a likely route'), so the main content of the problem is unproved.
